HU-05_on_demand_revalidation.description: On-demand ISR (Incremental Static Regeneration) for service pages

components.description: Protected API endpoint for triggering page revalidation
Integrated triggerRevalidate calls in CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE operations

features: Automatic revalidation on service CRUD operations
Fallback to JWT auth if REVALIDATE_SECRET not set

features: Automatic upload to Cloudinary on file selection

environment_variables.name: REVALIDATE_SECRET
environment_variables.description: Secret token to protect revalidate endpoint. Falls back to JWT auth if not set.

environment_variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
environment_variables.description: Base URL for revalidate API calls. Defaults to http://localhost:3000

vercel_deployment_steps: 1. Set environment variables in Vercel Dashboard → Settings → Environment Variables
2. Ensure NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL points to your production domain
3. Deploy from develop branch or merge PRs and deploy
4. Test revalidate by creating a service in admin
5. Test image upload in production admin panel
6. Monitor Cloudinary usage in their dashboard
post_deployment_checks: ✓ Public catalog shows new services immediately
✓ No console errors related to Cloudinary or revalidate

known_limitations.description: 25 GB storage, 25 GB bandwidth/month on free tier
known_limitations.mitigation: Upgrade to paid plan or implement alternative storage (AWS S3, Vercel Blob)
Batch revalidations or upgrade to Pro plan
Increase limit in pages/api/admin/upload.ts if needed

revalidate_not_working: 1. Check server logs for 'Revalidated paths' or error messages
2. Verify NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL points to correct domain
3. Ensure REVALIDATE_SECRET is set in production env vars
4. Check CDN cache if using external CDN
upload_fails_500: 1. Verify Cloudinary credentials in env vars
2. Check server console for specific error
3. Verify file is valid image format
4. Check Cloudinary dashboard for quota limits
preview_not_showing: 1. Verify next.config.js includes Cloudinary in remotePatterns
2. Restart dev server after config changes
3. Check browser console for CORS/CSP errors

next_steps: 1. Set up Cloudinary account and get credentials
2. Add env vars to .env.local for local testing
5. After merge, set env vars in Vercel/production
6. Deploy to production and test end-to-end

summary.testing_required: Yes - manual testing of upload and revalidate
